customer_reply:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting us. Here is how to resolve this: In Okta download the new signing certificate, upload it in Security > SSO > Certificates, enable 'Dual certificate' for 24h, then remove the old one. Login loops after rotation are caused by an expired cert in the SP config. If this doesn't fix it, reply with the exact error message or a screenshot and we'll take it to our L2 team.
